headline: Power & Instrumentation holds 42nd AGM, adopts ESOP scheme
summary: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Ltd held its 42nd AGM on September 25, 2026. Key resolutions included adopting the PIGL ESOP Scheme 2026 and ratifying auditor appointments.

headline: Sharika Enterprises Allots 1.21 Cr Shares
summary: Sharika Enterprises Limited allotted 1.21 crore equity shares and 28.12 lakh warrants on a preferential basis, raising ₹17.47 crore in fresh capital.

headline: Lakshya Powertech wins Rs 276.37 Cr O&M order from Vedanta
summary: Lakshya Powertech secures a confirmed Rs 276.37 crore work order for O&M services. This large order significantly boosts the backlog, though negative operating cashflow in FY26 warrants monitoring of working capital efficiency.

headline: Supriya Lifescience AGM concludes with all resolutions passed
summary: Supriya Lifescience Limited held its 18th AGM on September 24, 2026. All five ordinary resolutions, including the final dividend and director reappointments, were passed with requisite majority.

headline: Tata Chemicals swaps KPMG for KNAV in UK units
summary: Tata Chemicals replaces KPMG LLP with KNAV Limited as statutory auditor for four UK subsidiaries, citing fee disputes. The change affects holding and operating entities including British Salt.
